feature_claim: OpenAI-compatible /v1 endpoint accepts chat, responses, embeddings and models requests
evidence_limit: Route surface counted from the archived tree; no live external client exercised

feature_claim: Client format is auto-detected and translated through an OpenAI pivot, with exact source:target pairs registered as direct routes
evidence_limit: Suite covers registered pairs only; unregistered pair behaviour is untested

feature_claim: Provider registry resolves upstream base URL, auth mode and model catalogue from one file per provider
evidence_limit: Byte-equality verifier proves the catalogue is unchanged, not that each upstream is reachable

feature_claim: Model alias resolution maps client-supplied ids to catalogue ids deterministically
evidence_limit: Verified as byte-equal token mapping; semantic correctness of a mapping is out of scope

feature_claim: Non-OpenAI upstreams with binary or framed wire formats are handled inside a dedicated executor rather than the translator
evidence_limit: Executor presence measured; no live binary round trip performed under this gate

feature_claim: Combo expansion turns one client model request into an ordered candidate list with fallback across entries
evidence_limit: Ordering proven by source reading and the existing suite; no timing or load evidence

feature_claim: Automatic multi-account fallback retries a quota-classified failure on the next eligible account with no client-visible failed attempt
evidence_limit: Holds only before the first client-visible byte; post-output failures are terminal by design

feature_claim: Selection is fill-first over a static priority order, so a healthy account stays selected until it is depleted, disabled, expired or incapable
evidence_limit: Depletion-triggered stickiness holds for fill-first; the round-robin strategy rotates on a use counter and does not satisfy it

feature_claim: Per-account per-model quota locks expire on a recorded reset timestamp and do not disable unrelated models
evidence_limit: Model-keyed quota scoping is enabled for a single provider; every other provider locks at account scope

feature_claim: When every account is blocked the response reports the earliest reset across blocking windows as protocol retry state
evidence_limit: Retry state only; no server-side event-driven wait exists, so the client owns the wait

feature_claim: A stream is buffered before the first client-visible byte so a pre-output upstream failure can be replayed exactly once
evidence_limit: One-shot latch proven by source reading; buffer ceiling under concurrent load is unmeasured

feature_claim: Continuity fallback to a single explicitly configured route when no primary account is eligible
evidence_limit: Fixture is red by construction; no resolver exists in the archived tree

feature_claim: Token-saver pre-translate hooks compress tool-result content in place and fail open on any error
evidence_limit: Fail-open behaviour read from source; compression ratio is unmeasured

feature_claim: Usage accounting records prompt, completion, reasoning and cache-read token counts per request
evidence_limit: No cache-creation bucket exists in the schema, so cache-write cost cannot be attributed

feature_claim: State persists to an embedded SQLite file resolved from the configured data directory, through a driver fallback chain that never requires a native build
evidence_limit: Fallback chain exercised through the default driver only during this gate

feature_claim: Schema migrations apply forward in order on an empty data directory to produce a clean install
evidence_limit: Fresh-install path is asserted by the suite. Predecessor-state coexistence is now asserted too: tests/unit/db-migration-chain.test.js proves a predecessor state directory beside the namespace is neither read nor changed, and that it lies outside the search path entirely

feature_claim: OAuth credential capture, refresh and expiry handling for browser-authorized providers
evidence_limit: Authorization URLs verified byte-equal; no live provider authorization was performed

feature_claim: Gateway API keys are issued and verified against a server-held secret, separate from upstream provider credentials
evidence_limit: Secret handling read from source; no penetration or key-rotation evidence

feature_claim: Client IP is derived from the TCP socket and attacker-supplied forwarding headers are stripped unless the peer is loopback
evidence_limit: Source-level guarantee; no adversarial header test was run under this gate

feature_claim: Dashboard UI manages connections, models, usage, statistics and settings from the same server process
evidence_limit: Rendering not visually reviewed; the isolated smoke port was owned by a foreign listener

feature_claim: A launcher package installs, starts, health-checks and stops the server as a standalone command
evidence_limit: Launcher not executed under this gate because the isolated port was not free

feature_claim: Container and compose definitions build and run the same server image
evidence_limit: Definitions present in the tree; no image build or container run was performed

feature_claim: A bounded-worker test suite plus committed baseline verifiers give a regression verdict against a known-fail catalogue
evidence_limit: Verdict is valid for the recorded runtime version and worker cap only

feature_claim: Third-party license and notice text required by review is retained verbatim and isolated from product-facing copy
evidence_limit: Retention is asserted for the top-level license file; no full dependency notice audit was run

feature_claim: Optional remote synchronization of configuration and usage to an external worker service
evidence_limit: The external worker directory is not part of this repository, so its handlers cannot be exercised here
